name: FindMyPart
intents: where can I find this discontinued part
I have a part number but cannot find it anywhere
identify this machine part from a photo or markings
identify a broken part from a serial plate label invoice diagram or fragment
tell me what evidence I still need before buying a replacement
find a replacement for an obsolete part
find a supersession or cross reference
find a salvage or donor part
find a fabrication path when the original part is unavailable
find a discontinued appliance tractor automotive marine industrial or equipment part
identify a hard-to-source part from markings measurements photos or equipment clues
find replacement donor salvage blueprint or fabrication paths when normal sourcing fails
authority: free evidence-aware Part Passport triage plus human-confirmed paid sourcing hunts
boundaries: Part Passport normalization is not fitment proof
reachable listings are source leads until separately verified
checkout creation is not payment proof
private vendor, analytics, session, command-center, and sales data are not public

offers.name: Quick Hunt
offers.scope: OEM, aftermarket/cross-reference, marketplace/NOS and documentation sourcing lanes

offers.name: Deep Hunt
offers.scope: Quick Hunt lanes plus salvage/donor and community/cross-reference lanes

offers.name: Rescue Hunt
offers.scope: Deep Hunt lanes plus blueprint, patent/documentation and fabrication/reverse-engineering lanes

commercial.payment_boundary: Explicit human confirmation is required before checkout. Provider verification is required before paid fulfillment.
